system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In March 2021, what was the minimum number of promoters required to form a private limited company in Thailand? Answer briefly, stating the number.
raw_response:
Under Thai law at that time, the applicable provision was **Section 1097 of the Civil and Commercial Code (CCC)**, as amended by the **Business Sector Development Act (No. 2) B.E. 2559 (2016)**.

This provision required a minimum of **three (3) promoters** to form a private limited company in Thailand as of March 2021.

(Note: This requirement was later reduced to **two (2) promoters** by an amendment that came into effect in **February 2023**, but in March 2021, the three-promoter minimum was still in force.)
